items.title: Captain Verne Streckfus Interview, 1960-09-22
items.q: And he had, uh, Stacy and the big spider back in the Georgia.

ctx.x: It was an air, air, air. What about the people like Steve Lewis and Jeff Stacy and those other piano players?

Well, we had them on the boat. We had, uh, in the early days, they played for a band, uh, Tony Catalano from Damport, Iowa. Had the best band in the part of the coming days. That was on the river. And he called the ponies, Iowans. And he had, uh, Stacy and the big spider back in the Georgia. And, uh, some very good men. But they traveled up and down the river. So we used to go from port to port in the summertime. And they would come to the water in the wintertime. And they would get off and the other band would…
We had any room or shorts. I guess there were all the good men, but they never went on to fame like Dix and that's days yet. That's right. That's too bad. So many good musicians never did get.
